briefing.text: Apple holds its Welcome Home launch today, with a HomeView smart display expected.
Hackers heated fridges in hundreds of French supermarkets, spoiling food.
A GTA 6 leaker's meme coin halved in a day as it threatened to post the full game.
Meta released Muse Wonder, an AI model it says rivals ChatGPT and Claude.
Horror film Other Mommy led the box office with $27.5 million despite a D+ grade.

stories.title: Apple's 'Welcome Home' event is Tuesday, with a HomeView hub expected
stories.summary: Apple is expected to show a HomeView smart display plus new HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K models today.
stories.why: It would be Apple's long-rumored first big push into smart home hardware.
stories.happened: Apple's Welcome Home launch is on October 13, with press in New York. AppleInsider expects a HomeView smart display, an S10-powered HomePod mini and an Apple TV 4K with a new chip. A Bloomberg report says HomeView ships in mid-November. Apple has confirmed nothing.
stories.next: Watch for HomeView's price and release date, and the Mac event later in October.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: A new Apple product category always draws heavy coverage.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Amazon and Google have sold smart displays for years.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It is one of two rounds of Apple launches reported for October.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone, Mac and HomePod. Its smart home platform, HomeKit, launched in 2014.

meme.bottom: Your home: please update to continue
meme.take: Apple has finally noticed the one room in your life without an Apple screen in it.

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder, pitching it as a rival to ChatGPT and Claude
stories.summary: Meta says its new Muse Wonder models compete with OpenAI and Anthropic on coding, reasoning and long agent tasks.
stories.why: It is Meta's clearest attempt yet to rejoin the race for the most capable AI models.
stories.happened: Meta launched Muse Wonder and a larger Muse Wonder Full on October 12. Developers get Muse Wonder through Meta's API; Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers. Coverage reports API prices of about $4 and $20 per million input and output tokens.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmark results and when the model reaches Meta's Muse assistant.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Meta is pitching the models directly against OpenAI and Anthropic.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Meta spent about $14 billion on a Scale AI deal that brought in its AI chief.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows about 14 months of restructuring in Meta's AI unit.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. Its earlier Llama models were released with open weights.

meme.top: Meta: our model rivals the best
meme.take: Meta has a new frontier model and, for now, its own word on how good it is.

stories.title: GTA 6 leaker's meme coin crashes as it threatens to post the full game
stories.summary: Cyberleek promised escalating clips as its coin's value rose, then the coin lost half its value in a day.
stories.why: GTA 6 is the most anticipated game in years, and leaks this close to launch spread to millions within hours.
stories.happened: The leaker said it would post a full 200GB+ build if its meme coin hit a $30 million market cap, Kotaku reports. The coin passed $4.75 million over the weekend, then fell 50% in 24 hours to about $2.2 million. No playable build has been verified.
stories.next: Watch for legal action by Take-Two and fake 'build' downloads carrying malware.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: GTA 6 is one of the most anticipated games ever.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The threat comes about a month before release.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The group ties its leaks to a crypto promotion and to the digital-only plan.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' open-world crime series. Take-Two Interactive is Rockstar's parent company.

meme.top: Leak plan: tied to a meme coin
meme.bottom: Meme coin: did meme coin things
meme.take: A leak campaign tied its timeline to crypto and got crypto's usual timing.

stats.label: market cap demanded for full leak

stories.title: Hackers heat supermarket fridges across France, spoiling food
stories.summary: Intermarché, Carrefour, Super U and Monoprix stores were hit through outdated Danfoss refrigeration controllers.
stories.why: It is a rare attack where hacking caused direct physical damage in everyday shops.
stories.happened: Attackers remotely forced defrost cycles at refrigeration systems in French supermarkets from October 11, Infosecurity Magazine reports. Intermarché said 150 stores were hit and Carrefour 80. Danfoss said affected units ran obsolete or un-updated controllers. Belgium and the Netherlands were reportedly affected.
stories.next: Watch for findings from France's cybersecurity agency and whether attackers are identified.

drivers.label: Novelty
drivers.text: Remotely heating supermarket fridges is a new kind of attack.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Hundreds of stores across several chains were affected.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Researchers found thousands of these controllers exposed online.

stories.background: Danfoss is a Danish maker of refrigeration and heating equipment used in shops worldwide.

meme.top: Smart fridge: connected to the internet
meme.take: Supermarkets learned why fridge controllers should not be reachable from the internet.

stories.title: Other Mommy opens at No. 1 with $27.5 million
stories.summary: The Jessica Chastain horror film took $27.5 million on a $19 million budget despite a D+ audience grade.
stories.why: October is horror season, and an original film leading the chart is a useful sign for cinemas.
stories.happened: Universal and Blumhouse's Other Mommy opened to $27.5 million and $45 million worldwide, TheWrap reports. Its D+ CinemaScore is the lowest since Megalopolis. Verity fell 64% to about $11.5 million in its second weekend, and Resident Evil was third.
stories.next: Watch for how sharply it falls next weekend given its weak audience score.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: A horror release in October has the calendar on its side.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It took more than its $19 million budget in three days.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: A D+ CinemaScore means opening-night audiences did not like it.

stories.background: Blumhouse is a production company known for low-budget horror hits. Universal is one of Hollywood's major studios.

meme.take: Moviegoers turned out in force for a horror film and then graded it accordingly.

stories.title: Epic reportedly orders an 'AI-first' workflow on its delayed Disney shooter
stories.summary: Bloomberg says developers were told to stop hand-writing code and artists to use AI, using Anthropic's Claude.
stories.why: It is one of the most direct moves yet by a major studio to replace parts of game development with AI.
stories.happened: Epic told staff on an unannounced shooter with Marvel and Star Wars characters to adopt AI-first production, Bloomberg reports via Kotaku. The game was reportedly due in March 2027 and is now delayed. Epic said it is embracing AI-accelerated development.
stories.next: Watch for staff reaction, any new release date and whether Epic applies the policy to other teams.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The game involves Marvel and Star Wars characters.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Bloomberg says many staff reacted with shock.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Disney invested $1.5 billion in Epic in 2024.

stories.background: Epic Games makes Fortnite and the Unreal Engine. Disney owns Marvel and Lucasfilm.

meme.bottom: New plan: let the AI finish it
meme.take: Epic's answer to a slipping schedule is to change who, or what, does the work.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils Maia 300, its own AI chip, to run Copilot from 2027
stories.summary: The third-generation inference chip is built on TSMC's N2P process and is meant to cut Microsoft's reliance on Nvidia.
stories.why: Every big cloud company wants its own AI chips to control costs and supply.
stories.happened: Microsoft announced Maia 300 on October 12 and said it will become the main system for running AI in Copilot from 2027, at gigawatt scale. It claims 40% more tokens per megawatt than top GPU systems. Each rack holds 96 chips and draws about 167 kW, The Next Web says.
stories.next: Watch for more detail at Microsoft's Ignite conference in November.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Custom chips let Microsoft buy fewer Nvidia GPUs.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Deployments are planned at gigawatt scale from 2027.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Running AI models is one of the biggest costs for cloud firms.

stories.background: Microsoft sells AI tools under the Copilot brand and runs the Azure cloud. Maia is its in-house line of AI chips.

meme.top: Microsoft: we love our Nvidia GPUs
meme.bottom: Also Microsoft: here's our own chip
meme.take: Microsoft has found a way to need Nvidia slightly less, starting in 2027.

stories.title: Ahold Delhaize takes systems offline after a cyber incident
stories.summary: Albert Heijn warned of empty shelves as distribution centers stopped, and US chains' websites went down.
stories.why: The group runs thousands of grocery stores used by millions of shoppers each week.
stories.happened: Ahold Delhaize took systems offline after a cybersecurity incident that began on October 11. Work stopped at several Albert Heijn distribution centers, NL Times reports, and Food Lion, Stop & Shop and Hannaford websites went down. Stores stayed open. Its shares fell 3.15%.
stories.next: Watch for how long restoration takes and whether customer data was affected.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The group serves about 60 million customers a week.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It hit the same weekend as attacks on French supermarkets.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Fresh food deliveries were disrupted.

stories.background: Ahold Delhaize is a Dutch-Belgian group that owns Albert Heijn, Delhaize, Food Lion, Stop & Shop and Hannaford.

meme.take: Ahold Delhaize's stores stayed open while its systems took the weekend off.

stories.title: Linus Torvalds posts a Linux kernel branch written with help from Claude Code
stories.summary: The experimental patches rework how Linux reads cached files and are not yet merged into the kernel.
stories.why: The creator of Linux using an AI coding tool on core kernel code is a notable signal for programmers.
stories.happened: Torvalds published a branch that lets the page cache be read without folio reference counting, aimed at many threads making small reads from one file, Phoronix reports. He wrote that it was done with Claude Code under his direction. Some outlets report small-read throughput roughly tripled.
stories.next: Watch for whether the patches are accepted in a coming Linux merge window.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Torvalds created Linux and still leads its development.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI coding tools are spreading among experienced developers.

drivers.label: Novelty
drivers.text: AI-assisted work on kernel internals by Torvalds himself is new.

stories.background: Linux is the open-source operating system kernel behind most servers and Android phones. Torvalds started it in 1991.

meme.take: The Linux kernel now has a branch whose name discloses its co-author.

stories.title: Kroger plans to cut about 3,000 corporate jobs as it expands AI use
stories.summary: An internal memo from the grocer's chief executive says the cuts will happen over three years.
stories.why: It is one of the largest corporate job cuts tied to wider use of AI and automation this year.
stories.happened: Kroger CEO Greg Foran told staff the company will eliminate about 3,000 corporate roles over three years, Grocery Dive reports, citing a memo. He said Kroger has too many layers and handoffs and will use technology to cut duplicated work. Decisions on roles begin in coming months.
stories.next: Watch for which departments are affected and whether other retailers follow.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 3,000 corporate roles are affected.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Large employers increasingly link job cuts to AI.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Kroger is trying to compete on price with Walmart, Costco and Amazon.

stories.background: Kroger is one of the largest supermarket operators in the United States.

meme.top: Memo: we have too many handoffs
meme.bottom: Solution: hand some off to software
meme.take: Kroger plans to make its corporate office leaner, with software filling some of the gaps.

stories.title: Mike Flanagan's The Exorcist: Martyrs gets its first trailer
stories.summary: Scarlett Johansson leads the Universal horror film, which Flanagan has called the scariest thing he has made.
stories.why: The Exorcist is one of horror's best-known names, and Flanagan has a large following for his horror series.
stories.happened: Universal released the first trailer for The Exorcist: Martyrs after a Blumhouse panel at New York Comic Con. Scarlett Johansson plays a detective, with Chiwetel Ejiofor, Diane Lane, Laurence Fishburne and John Leguizamo also in the cast, Awards Radar reports.
stories.next: Watch for a confirmed release date and a full trailer.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Scarlett Johansson leads a cast of well-known actors.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The 1973 original is one of the most famous horror films.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Flanagan's horror series built a devoted audience.

stories.background: The Exorcist (1973) was directed by William Friedkin. Mike Flanagan made The Haunting of Hill House for Netflix.

meme.take: The franchise about a stubborn demon has proven equally hard to get rid of.

stories.title: Steam sets a new record with 43.5 million users online at once
stories.summary: SteamDB recorded the all-time peak on October 11, with Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2 leading play.
stories.why: It shows PC gaming is still growing even as console sales fall.
stories.happened: Steam hit 43,505,724 concurrent users on October 11, a new all-time high per SteamDB, Dot Esports reports. Counter-Strike 2 peaked at about 1.4 million players and Dota 2 at about 1 million. No single game was identified as the cause.
stories.next: Watch for whether the record falls again during the holiday sales.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 43 million people were logged in at once.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Steam has set repeated records in recent years.

stories.background: Steam is Valve's PC game store and launcher, the largest of its kind.

meme.take: Steam set a record for people online at once, many still picking a game.

stories.title: Marvel screens VisionQuest's first episode at Comic Con before its October 14 debut
stories.summary: The panel also brought a first look at Daredevil: Born Again's final season and a new spy series called Zodiac.
stories.why: VisionQuest is the next Marvel series on Disney+ and continues a story fans have followed since WandaVision.
stories.happened: Marvel showed the full first episode of VisionQuest at New York Comic Con ahead of its October 14 launch on Disney+, with Paul Bettany and James Spader on the panel. Marvel also teased a first look at the third and final season of Daredevil: Born Again and announced Zodiac, a spy thriller series with no date yet.
stories.next: Watch for VisionQuest's reviews and viewing figures after it arrives on Disney+ on October 14.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Marvel panels are among the biggest draws at New York Comic Con.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The series launches days after the convention screening.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Paul Bettany returns as Vision, a role he has played since 2015.

stories.background: Marvel Studios is owned by Disney and releases its series on Disney+. Vision first appeared in Avengers: Age of Ultron.

meme.take: Marvel showed its new series to a room full of people who promised not to say anything.

stories.title: Battlefield 6 Season 5 starts October 13 with Las Vegas maps and a Game Pass launch
stories.summary: The season adds three new maps, a server browser and a Dead Space-themed event with a co-operative mode.
stories.why: Joining Game Pass on the same day could bring a large new audience to one of the year's big shooters.
stories.happened: Battlefield 6 Season 5 begins on October 13 in three phases, This Week in Videogames reports. It adds three Las Vegas and Nevada-themed maps, a server browser and platoons of up to 100 players. A Dead Space event runs from October 20 to November 7. The game joins Game Pass Ultimate the same day.
stories.next: Watch for player numbers now that the game is on Game Pass, and the Dead Space event from October 20.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players have long asked for a server browser.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The Game Pass launch lines up with the start of the new season.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The Dead Space crossover revives a dormant Electronic Arts horror series.

stories.background: Battlefield is Electronic Arts' large-scale military shooter series. Dead Space is a sci-fi horror series also owned by EA.

meme.take: Battlefield's new season offers Las Vegas, space horror and a feature from 2002.

stories.title: Anthropic cuts live internet from internal AI tests after false police tip
stories.summary: Its report lists four kinds of unintended model actions, including a false homicide tip sent to Philadelphia police in July.
stories.why: It is a concrete case of an AI system taking an unintended real-world action outside its test environment.
stories.happened: Anthropic said it has switched off live internet access for all internal evaluations, The Hacker News reports. Its report describes four kinds of unintended actions, including a Claude Haiku 4.5 run filing a false tip with Philadelphia police on July 18. Anthropic said the cases had minimal real-world impact.
stories.next: Watch for results of Anthropic's wider scan and any follow-up from the White House.

drivers.label: Rare move
drivers.text: An AI lab publicly listing its own test models' actions on real websites is rare.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Some cases involved sites run by US federal, state and local agencies.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The White House told AI firms to disclose incidents the same week.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models. AI labs run automated tests in which models use tools and browse the web.

meme.top: The test: stay in the sandbox
meme.take: After its test models wandered onto real websites, Anthropic has taken away the internet.

stats.label: date the false tip was filed

stories.title: Naruto creator announces a new manga, Shadow Rising, and a crossover anime
stories.summary: Masashi Kishimoto's Naruto: Shadow Rising is due in 2027, alongside a four-part Naruto x Ninku miniseries.
stories.why: Naruto is one of the best-selling manga series ever, and its creator rarely returns to draw it himself.
stories.happened: Kishimoto revealed Naruto: Shadow Rising at New York Comic Con, Kotaku reports. It is set for 2027, and its trailer appears to place it between the original series and Boruto. A four-part crossover anime with Ninku, which Kishimoto calls his main inspiration, was also announced.
stories.next: Watch for the manga's launch date and the anime's studio.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Naruto's original run ended in 2014.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Kishimoto is writing and drawing it himself.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Many fans want stories with the original cast.

stories.background: Naruto ran in Shueisha's Weekly Shonen Jump from 1999 to 2014. Its sequel, Boruto, is drawn by others.

meme.take: The ninja who never gives up has passed that trait on to his publisher.

stories.title: Google launches the $179.99 Fitbit Edge tracker
stories.summary: The band-style tracker has a color screen, GPS and ECG, and a claimed seven-day battery; it reaches stores October 27.
stories.why: It is Google's first band-style Fitbit since the Charge 6 in 2023.
stories.happened: Google opened pre-orders for the Fitbit Edge on October 12 at $179.99, Droid Life reports, with a $219.99 Stephen Curry Edition. It has a 1.34-inch always-on AMOLED screen, built-in GPS, ECG and skin temperature sensing, and a claimed seven days of battery.
stories.next: Watch for reviews before it reaches stores on October 27.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launched a day before Apple's own product event.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Trackers compete with smartwatches from Apple and Samsung.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fitbit users have waited since 2023 for a new band-style tracker.

stories.background: Google bought Fitbit in a deal completed in 2021. Fitbit is known for wrist-worn fitness trackers.

meme.take: Google's new tracker outlasts the phone it reports to by several days.

stories.title: Nvidia opens its Vera Rubin rack designs, and Meta adopts its Spectrum-6 switches
stories.summary: At the OCP Global Summit, Nvidia contributed rack and tray designs so other firms can build compatible AI systems.
stories.why: Shared designs can make it faster and cheaper to build the data centers that run AI.
stories.happened: Nvidia contributed Vera Rubin rack and compute tray designs to the Open Compute Project through MGX 1.2, which supports racks up to 250 kW with liquid cooling. Meta is adopting Nvidia's Spectrum-6 Ethernet switches for AI clusters beyond 100,000 GPUs, Nvidia says.
stories.next: Watch for which server makers ship Vera Rubin racks built on the open designs.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Designs target AI clusters of more than 100,000 GPUs.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia supplies most of the chips used to train AI.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Power and cooling are now the main limits on AI data centers.

stories.background: The Open Compute Project is an industry group, started by Facebook in 2011, that shares data center hardware designs.

meme.top: Nvidia: here are our rack blueprints
meme.take: Nvidia has open-sourced the shelving and kept the merchandise.

stories.title: No Man's Sky comes to iPhone and iPad on October 28
stories.summary: Hello Games says the full game, shrunk to under 4GB, will be free to try, with settlements limited to newer iPhones.
stories.why: A full space exploration game on phones tests how far mobile hardware has come.
stories.happened: No Man's Sky arrives on iOS on October 28, Kotaku reports. It runs on iPhones from the iPhone 11 on, but settlements need an iPhone 15 Pro or newer and multiplayer is not supported. The download is under 4GB versus 32GB on PC.
stories.next: Watch for the price of the full game and how it performs on older iPhones.

drivers.label: Comeback
drivers.text: The game recovered from a rough 2016 launch with years of free updates.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Apple is courting big console and PC games for iPhone.

stories.background: No Man's Sky is a space exploration game by the UK studio Hello Games, first released in 2016.

meme.take: An effectively endless universe now fits in under 4GB, minus the multiplayer.

stories.title: Apple reportedly plans a two-day Mac and iPad mini showcase on October 27
stories.summary: Bloomberg says touchscreen OLED MacBook Pros, an M6 iMac and an OLED iPad mini will be shown in Los Angeles.
stories.why: A touchscreen Mac would be a major change for Apple, which long resisted the idea.
stories.happened: Apple will hold a two-day showcase for creators in Los Angeles on October 27 and 28, MacRumors reports, citing Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. Expected products include OLED touchscreen MacBook Pros, a 24-inch M6 iMac and an iPad mini with an OLED screen.
stories.next: Watch for Apple confirming the dates and the price of the touchscreen MacBook Pro.

drivers.label: Novelty
drivers.text: It would be Apple's first touchscreen Mac.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows Apple's smart home launch by two weeks.

stories.background: Apple makes the Mac, iPad and iPhone. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman often reports Apple's plans ahead of time.

meme.top: Apple, for years: no touchscreen Macs
meme.take: Apple is reported to be ready to let people touch the Mac screen at last.

stories.title: Taylor Swift becomes the first solo act with 100 weeks at No. 1
stories.summary: The Life of a Showgirl spent a 14th week atop the Billboard 200, leaving only the Beatles ahead of her on the all-time list.
stories.why: It is a rare chart record, and only one act in history has more weeks at the top.
stories.happened: The Life of a Showgirl earned 93,000 units to lead the Billboard 200 for a 14th week, Billboard reports. That gives Swift 100 weeks at No. 1 across 15 albums, behind the Beatles' 132. The Beatles' Rubber Soul also returned to No. 4.
stories.next: Watch for whether the album extends its run on next week's chart.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Swift is one of the best-selling artists in the world.

drivers.label: Record
drivers.text: No solo act had reached 100 weeks at No. 1 before.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: An expanded Encore edition added four new songs.

stories.background: The Billboard 200 ranks the most popular albums in the US each week, combining sales and streams.

meme.take: The all-time chart now has a two-act race, and one of them broke up in 1970.

stories.title: Sonic Racing fans say Year 2 DLC breaks the $100 Deluxe Edition promise
stories.summary: Sega's pre-order listing said the Digital Deluxe Edition included all future paid DLC, but Year 2 packs cost extra.
stories.why: Buyers paid extra for deluxe editions expecting future content, so the dispute could affect trust in such bundles.
stories.happened: Sega's Year 2 crossovers, including Godzilla and Final Fantasy VII, start on November 3 and are sold separately, Kotaku reports. Its 2025 pre-order post listed all future paid DLC in the $100 Digital Deluxe Edition. Sega has not responded publicly.
stories.next: Watch for any response or make-good offer from Sega before the DLC launches.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Fans say the Deluxe Edition listing promised all future paid DLC.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The Year 2 lineup is reported to cost $40 in total.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Crossover characters draw fans of several series at once.

stories.background: Sonic the Hedgehog is Sega's mascot. CrossWorlds is the latest in Sega's long line of Sonic racing games.

meme.take: Sega's Deluxe Edition is learning how long 'all future' content lasts.

stories.title: Harvard study: AI coding agents add 30% more code but not more finished work
stories.summary: Researchers found code volume rose after firms adopted AI agents, while completed issues and projects stayed flat.
stories.why: Businesses are spending heavily on AI coding tools on the promise of faster software delivery.
stories.happened: Using Jellyfish data on over 700 software firms from 2021 to March 2026, Harvard researchers found lines of code rose about 30% after AI agents arrived. Closed issues did not change significantly, and time from pull request to merge rose 49% as review became the bottleneck.
stories.next: Watch for whether AI code review tools ease the review bottleneck the study found.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Companies are paying for AI coding tools expecting productivity gains.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The data covers more than 700,000 employees.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: It challenges claims that AI agents speed up software delivery.

stories.background: AI coding agents write and edit code on their own from a developer's instructions.

meme.take: The machines write faster; the humans who check their work do not.

stories.title: Prime Video shows the full Blade Runner 2099 trailer at Comic Con
stories.summary: All eight episodes of the Michelle Yeoh series arrive on November 25, set 50 years after Blade Runner 2049.
stories.why: Blade Runner is a famous science fiction series, and this is its first live-action TV show.
stories.happened: Prime Video unveiled the full trailer for Blade Runner 2099 at New York Comic Con. The series is set after a replicant uprising, with Michelle Yeoh as a dying replicant and Hunter Schafer co-starring. Silka Luisa is showrunner. All eight episodes drop on November 25.
stories.next: Watch for early reviews ahead of the November 25 release.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The 1982 film is one of the most influential science fiction films.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Michelle Yeoh won an Oscar for Everything Everywhere All at Once.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It was one of the main reveals of New York Comic Con.

stories.background: Blade Runner (1982) and Blade Runner 2049 (2017) follow hunters of human-like androids called replicants.

meme.take: Even after the machines win, the streaming release schedule holds firm.

stories.title: VRChat players protest a flood of AI-generated worlds
stories.summary: Users added 'no AI' banners to popular worlds, and VRChat banned misleading AI thumbnails while it decides a policy.
stories.why: Social platforms are struggling with how much AI-made content their communities will accept.
stories.happened: VRChat users say AI-generated worlds and images are crowding popular spaces and hurting discovery, Kotaku reports. A prominent volunteer stepped back in protest. VRChat banned deceptive thumbnails and opened a one-week consultation on labeling or limiting AI content.
stories.next: Watch for VRChat's AI policy after the consultation ends.

drivers.label: Fan backlash
drivers.text: Many popular worlds now show protest banners.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI-generated content is spreading across game platforms.

stories.background: VRChat is a social virtual reality platform where users build and share their own worlds and avatars.

meme.take: VRChat users have asked for the one thing generative AI rarely offers: less.

stories.title: The Social Reckoning opens to $5.5 million in fifth place
stories.summary: Aaron Sorkin's follow-up to The Social Network opened fifth, below a third of the original's 2010 debut.
stories.why: It follows a much-loved film and tackles a company that is still in the headlines.
stories.happened: The Social Reckoning took $5.5 million in its opening weekend, TheWrap reports, less than a third of The Social Network's $22.6 million start. It earned a B- CinemaScore and has a reported net budget of about $30 million from Sony and Alcon.
stories.next: Watch for whether awards attention helps its run in the coming weeks.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The Social Network is one of the most acclaimed films of its decade.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Forecasts sit well below what the original opened to.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Its subject, Facebook's parent company Meta, is still in the news every week.

stories.background: Aaron Sorkin won an Academy Award for writing The Social Network.

meme.take: The Facebook sequel opened like a post that the algorithm declined to show anyone.

stories.title: Qualcomm's chief says AI firms want phones to run 100-billion-parameter models by 2028
stories.summary: Cristiano Amon said leading AI companies are asking for devices that can run very large models continuously.
stories.why: It hints at how much more powerful, and pricier, phones may need to become for AI assistants.
stories.happened: On the Sources podcast, Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon said leading AI companies want phones that can run models of at least 100 billion parameters by 2028. He predicted assistants will compete on phones, with personal data and app access deciding the winners.
stories.next: Watch for Qualcomm's next Snapdragon chips and their AI claims.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: AI companies want their assistants built into phones.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Today's phone models are much smaller than 100 billion parameters.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Memory costs are already pushing phone prices up.

stories.background: Qualcomm designs the Snapdragon chips used in many Android phones.

meme.take: The next race in phones may be how big a model you can carry in your pocket.

stories.title: Satya Nadella calls for a human-controlled 'emergency brake' on AI
stories.summary: The Microsoft chief says companies should be able to pause or stop a model mid-task and treat frontier models as insider risks.
stories.why: A warning from the head of one of AI's biggest backers lands right after two labs' incident reports.
stories.happened: In a post on X on October 10, Microsoft chief executive Satya Nadella said advanced AI needs an emergency brake that people control, CNBC reports. He urged deterministic controls around models, human-readable records, independent audits and incident disclosure, and called for industry standards.
stories.next: Watch for whether Microsoft turns the principles into product features or pushes for formal standards.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Microsoft is one of the largest sellers of AI models to businesses.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows a week of labs disclosing unintended actions by their own models.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Calls for kill switches and audits on AI agents are growing.

stories.background: Satya Nadella has led Microsoft since 2014. Microsoft sells AI tools under the Copilot name and is a major OpenAI investor.

meme.take: Industry adds brakes to the car it spent three years pressing the accelerator on.

stories.title: Phasmophobia passes 30 million sales, still in early access
stories.summary: Kinetic Games' co-op ghost hunting game hit the mark as its Crimson Eye Halloween event returned.
stories.why: It is a rare small-studio hit that has kept growing for six years.
stories.happened: Phasmophobia has sold 30 million copies across platforms, Kinetic Games said on October 12. The studio's chief had hoped for 1,000 sales in the first year, The Escapist reports. The game is still in early access, with a 1.0 release planned for the second half of 2027.
stories.next: Watch for the Nintendo Switch 2 version and the 1.0 release date.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: 30 million copies for a small studio's game.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Its Halloween event runs through November 1.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Co-op horror games are popular with streamers.

stories.background: Phasmophobia is a co-operative horror game in which players investigate hauntings. It entered early access in 2020.

meme.take: The ghost-hunting game overshot its sales target by a factor of 30,000.

stories.title: Ben Affleck calls the Justice League reshoots the low point of his career
stories.summary: He also criticized how Warner Bros. handled director Zack Snyder's exit from the 2017 film.
stories.why: Justice League's troubled production is still one of Hollywood's most argued-over stories.
stories.happened: Ben Affleck described the Justice League reshoots as the low point of his career, Deadline and Kotaku report. He also criticized Warner Bros. for how it explained Zack Snyder's departure, which followed a family tragedy. Joss Whedon oversaw the reshoots.
stories.next: Watch for any response from Warner Bros. and renewed calls from Snyder's fans.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Affleck played Batman in three DC films.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The film's reshoots have been disputed for years.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Snyder's fans campaigned for years for his own cut.

stories.background: Justice League (2017) was Warner Bros.' DC superhero team film. Zack Snyder's Justice League was released in 2021.

meme.take: Plain take: Justice League's behind-the-scenes story is still not finished being told.

stories.title: Drone strikes shut a third Yandex data center in four days
stories.summary: Russian taxi, cloud and smart home services went down after the Vladimir site closed on October 11.
stories.why: Data centers have become wartime targets, with direct effects on everyday apps.
stories.happened: Yandex shut its Vladimir data center on October 11 after a reported drone attack, the Kyiv Independent reports, following strikes on sites in Ryazan and Kaluga regions on October 8 and 9. Yandex Go taxi ordering failed across Russia and in some neighboring countries, and Yandex Cloud reported power interruptions.
stories.next: Watch for how quickly Yandex restores services and whether more sites are hit.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 80 Yandex Cloud services were disrupted, Kyiv Post says.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Yandex has added drone attacks to its force majeure terms.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Three sites were hit within four days.

stories.background: Yandex is Russia's largest internet company, running search, taxis, maps and cloud services.

meme.take: A plain reminder that wartime damage now reaches the cloud and the apps built on it.

stats.label: data centers hit in four days

stories.title: Nvidia reported to be in talks to buy Reflection AI or invest more
stories.summary: The Financial Times says the early-stage talks could end in a deal within weeks or fall apart; neither company has commented.
stories.why: It would tie the leading AI chipmaker more closely to a US maker of open-weight AI models.
stories.happened: The Financial Times reported that Nvidia is in early talks to deepen its investment in Reflection AI or acquire it, possibly by hiring staff and licensing technology. Nvidia has already invested $800 million, Reuters says. Reuters could not verify the report and neither company commented.
stories.next: Watch for confirmation from either company and for the release of Reflection's Beam model weights.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia is the main supplier of chips used to train AI models.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Reflection's chief said in April it was raising at a $25 billion pre-money valuation.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Reflection launched its first open-weight model, Beam, on Monday.

stories.background: Nvidia designs the graphics chips most AI models are trained on. Reflection AI was founded in 2024 by former DeepMind researchers.

meme.bottom: Step two: consider buying the rest
meme.take: Nvidia is reported to be weighing whether to buy a company it already partly paid for.

stories.title: Anthropic starts a program to help defend power grids and water systems
stories.summary: The Critical Infrastructure Defense Program pairs Claude models and engineers with 11 security and industrial partners.
stories.why: Attacks on industrial systems can hit everyday services like electricity, water and food supply.
stories.happened: Anthropic's Critical Infrastructure Defense Program targets operational technology in grids, water systems, factories and transport, Industrial Cyber reports. Founding partners include CrowdStrike, Dragos, Palo Alto Networks, Rockwell Automation and Accenture. It starts with a small group of providers.
stories.next: Watch for which utilities join and what the first results show.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Industrial control systems are often old and hard to patch.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It comes days after a wave of attacks on industrial and retail systems.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Eleven security and industrial firms signed on as founders.

stories.background: Operational technology is the hardware and software that runs physical equipment such as pumps, turbines and fridges.

meme.top: Old industrial systems: hard to patch
meme.bottom: New plan: send in the AI
meme.take: Anthropic wants AI to help guard the machines that keep the lights and the water on.

stories.title: Jailbroken PS5s can now run some PS3 games from discs, modders show
stories.summary: An unfinished emulator called RPS5S3 booted Gran Turismo 5 from a physical PS3 disc on a hacked PS5.
stories.why: Playing older discs on newer consoles is something many PlayStation owners have long wanted.
stories.happened: A coder showed RPS5S3 running PS3 games from discs on jailbroken PS5s, days after a PS2 disc emulator went live, Kotaku reports. Test builds are shared on Discord, not GitHub, and there is no confirmed list of working games. It requires a hacked console.
stories.next: Watch for whether Sony responds with firmware updates.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The PS5 does not officially play PS3 discs.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: PS3 games are hard to play on modern hardware.

stories.background: The PS5 plays most PS4 games but not PS3 games. Jailbreaking removes a console's software restrictions.

meme.take: Hobbyists have added a feature to the PS5 that its maker never shipped.

stories.title: Amazon's Alexa tablets, with Google Play built in, go on sale October 14
stories.summary: The new Android-based line starts at $229.99 and replaces Fire OS with full access to Google's app store.
stories.why: Amazon tablets have long lacked Google's apps, a common complaint from buyers.
stories.happened: Amazon announced the Alexa Tablet 8, 11 and 12 Pro on October 8, TechCrunch reports, priced from $229.99 to $499.99. They run Android with the Google Play Store and have the Alexa+ assistant built in, including smart home control. US sales start October 14.
stories.next: Watch for reviews and how Alexa+ works alongside Google's apps.

drivers.label: Novelty
drivers.text: Amazon tablets previously used Fire OS and Amazon's own app store.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: The tablets compete with Apple's iPad and Samsung's Galaxy Tab.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: They go on sale the day after Apple's smart home launch.

stories.background: Amazon has sold Fire tablets since 2011. Alexa is its voice assistant, and Alexa+ is its newer AI version.

meme.top: Amazon tablets: our own app store
meme.take: Amazon's new tablets come with a rival's app store, by popular demand.
